en: Colorized historic street view showing a gently curving cobblestone road lined with old townhouses on the right and a large building with a steep hipped roof and small tower on the left, likely the town hall by the market square. A few pedestrians are visible in the foreground. The sky is tinted in pastel evening colors. German text is printed at the top and on a shop sign to the right.
